rationale: Static list of TED eSenders — mine once to identify SK upstream systems, not a recurring signal feed.
Operational OJ S calendar page on ted.europa.eu; useful for scheduling but covered by monitoring TED itself.
SIMAP reference documentation (thresholds, CPV) — rulebook material, sub-page of the TED/SIMAP estate.
EUR-Lex OJ direct access is a durable authoritative archive for SK-language legal confirmation of procurement and banking rules.
EU Funding & Tenders Portal is a standalone tender source capturing EU-institution contracts involving Slovak banking/payments actors.
API/data-model wiki mined once to build automated retrieval from the F&T Portal.
ECEPP is the sole channel for EBRD-financed notices affecting SK, but access_status unknown and legal_status unclear — confirm terms and any registration requirement.
EBRD institutional landing page routing to ECEPP; adds guidance context but no independent notice stream.
EBRD corporate procurement publishes its own advisory/IT assignments that can pre-signal CEE financial-infrastructure projects.
EIB project register is a durable, queryable source naming Slovak financial intermediaries and their funding envelopes.
EIB press stream is a recurring early-signal feed on SK operations; monitor the country feed rather than the single 2026 release.
MF SR IFI relationship page is a static sub-page of the ministry site already covered by monitoring mfsr.sk.
WBG procurement dataset — Slovakia is non-borrowing so expected near-zero yield; legal terms unclear; revisit only if RAS work emerges.
Opentender SK is a valuable harmonised cross-check but url_verification failed and reuse terms are unclear — recheck liveness and licence.
Publications Office secondary rendering of TED records; redundant with TED as the primary feed.
eForms-SDK repo is a live technical reference and changelog for the schemas any TED collector depends on.
ÚVO Vestník is the core national bulletin carrying below-threshold SK banking/payment contracts absent from TED.
ÚVO supervision hub is the durable master entry point linking every SK procurement remedy and oversight register.
Objection-decision register discloses bid values, criteria and disqualifications for SK bank/payment/POS tenders.
Strategic-agenda námietky track covers large-value payment-infrastructure and bank-service procurements.
ÚVO curated decision digests recur and reveal patterns shaping how SK banking tenders are written and contested.
Administrative-offence register exposes direct awards of bank/payment services with values and legal reasoning.
Inspection register including ex-ante files gives early warning on tender design before award.
Rada ÚVO appeal decisions are the fullest legal record, though now largely a historical archive for pre-2023 cases.
